method: Direct visual inspection of actual Godot PNGs and per-room contact sheets. Revised captures were re-inspected.

rooms.notes: Skiff and stepped river edge are visible in eye-level and overview; shoulder figure establishes the dock scale.
Bronze wheel and raised watergate are readable. The close views and overview show the chamber footprint.
Branching root island provides a tall focal point. The surrounding floor remains visibly open.
Double bunks, company banners and weapon racks distinguish the barracks from the shrine rooms.
The revised eye-level pose shows the ember furnace mouth. Shoulder and overview retain the forge context.
Hunter reliefs, banners and broken upper stonework distinguish the cloister; a pier provides foreground framing.
The connected review uses the approved fountain, roots and shrine architecture. The original sample source is unchanged.
The shoulder capture shows the book galleries. The final eye-level capture shows the water court with a foreground pier on the right; the overview shows the crescent shoreline.
Blood obelisks and red banners remain readable. The central ritual floor is visibly open.
The bronze reliquary and gilded apse provide the reward-room focal point.
The pipe organ and suspended lights are readable, with a clear ceremonial nave.
Large luminous mushroom canopies distinguish the boss arena. The overview shows the full lobed footprint.
Relic chest, crypt ornaments and wall niches provide a distinct cache treatment.
Revised close views face the stair approach and luminous threshold; the overview retains the dogleg footprint.

map_overview: The complete connected layout fits within the frame. The overview is not the close-camera quality test.
limits: Subjective art review, not user approval of the new rooms.
No claim of combat readiness or complete traversal coverage.
